reviews.title: Clunky
reviews.text:
Overall layout and design not very intuitive. Redundant/poor navigation when it comes to going through teams/divisions/players. It just seems like it does the bare minimum, not very well, and that no attempt was ever made to polish the v1 of the app.

Update since it’s asking for one. The app is still bad, actually has gotten worse. Imagine being a dev and seeing the feedback and not taking a single step in the right direction. lolz.

reviews.title: Skill level
reviews.text: Update is horrible, it removed the skill levels of people or yourself when you go to your stats or looking at other peoples stats. It used to show in the upper right hand corner the skill level for 8/9 but not anymore. The only way to see is to go to teams then select a team to see their/your skill. Total trash!!! It only gives total games played/ winning percentage. You also can’t see anyone that doesn’t play in the areas that you don’t play in. For example, if I play for a certain area (we all know it’s a franchise thing) I cannot see ( nor can my league operator aka franchise owner) a persons stats/skill level. It’s not like the Fargo app that you can look anyone up to find their Fargo rating. So now if I choose to play a tournament and it’s required to prove my skill level I have to pull up a current team to show my skill. Prior it would show my/their skill for8/9 in the upper right hand corner. Total trash

reviews.title: New Update
reviews.text: It doesn’t show skill level on the top of the screen anymore. When I play on multiple teams it’s more of a hassle to see my skill level and now difficult to see my teammates’ skill levels. When they play on multiple nights as well and have a different skill level on sunday than wednesday how do I know which is up to date?

reviews.title: Why was this removed?
reviews.text: Not sure why the skill level display when clicking on somebodies profile has gone away, that just makes it one step longer to see by clicking on teams and seeing the skill level. If thats a glitch I apologize for the 1 star

reviews.title: Was good....
reviews.text: It was good until you took away the skill level badges on each players page.  Now it’s a big PITA.

reviews.title: Skill Level Missing
reviews.text: Used to be my current skill level was posted prominently in the upper right of the screen. It’s no longer there and I have to go hunting for it to see if my skill level has changed for both 8 & 9 ball.

reviews.title: Doesn’t Work
reviews.text: Current version does not work. Just a white screen. I deleted the app and reinstalled but it still does not work.

reviews.title: Always waiting, no connection kills function
reviews.text: This app is designed to always be connected which means that if you play at a place with spotty connection - you’re hosed. 9ball is impossible to keep straight unless you constantly have connection. Our league operator never updates things right and I’ve missed so many patches because of it

reviews.title: Bad set up
reviews.text: Keeps kicking you out and won’t load up takes forever. Trying to score just bad

reviews.title: Apps keep crashing
reviews.text: Both the pool league and scorekeeper apps are crashing on a recurring basis. It’s past time to develop new apps!!!

reviews.title: Glitch
reviews.text:
You can't see a good amount of players profiles. It says "Whoops"
Please fix that!
